+1 to attack and damage. Action, once per dawn: coat the blade in poison for 1 minute or until it hits. On that hit the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save: 2d10 poison damage and poisoned for 1 minute on a failure. (Rare)
Bonus action: speak the command word to ignite the blade (bright light 40 ft, dim 40 ft more). While ablaze it deals an extra 2d6 fire damage on a hit. (Rare, requires attunement; any sword)

Extra 1d6 cold damage on a hit; resistance to fire while you hold it. In freezing temperatures it sheds bright light 10 ft. Once per hour, draw it to extinguish nonmagical flames within 30 ft. (Very rare, requires attunement; any sword)

+3 to attack and damage. Extra 2d10 radiant damage against fiends and undead. While drawn, it creates a 10-ft aura (30 ft at paladin level 17+): you and friendly creatures in it have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. (Legendary, requires attunement by a paladin)

+2 to attack and damage; deals radiant damage. Extra 1d8 radiant against undead. Bonus action: blade of radiance appears or vanishes; sheds bright light 15 ft (adjustable 10-30 ft). Proficiency with shortswords or longswords applies. (Rare, requires attunement; longsword)

Maximizes damage against objects. On a natural 20 against a creature, it takes an extra 4d6 slashing damage; then roll another d20: on a 20 you lop off one of its limbs. Command word: bright light 10 ft. (Very rare, requires attunement; any slashing sword)

Hit points lost to this weapon can be regained only by a short or long rest. Once per turn on a hit, you can wound the target: at the start of each of its turns it takes 1d4 necrotic damage per wound, until it succeeds on a DC 15 Constitution save at the end of its turn (ends all wounds) or someone uses an action on a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check. (Rare, requires attunement; any sword)

properties: Thrown (20/60), Versatile (1d8). Can cast spells to command sea life.
notes: 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn). Action, 1 charge: cast dominate beast (save DC 15) on a beast with an innate swimming speed. (Uncommon, requires attunement)

+3 to attack and damage; ignores resistance to slashing damage. On a natural 20 against a creature with at least one head, you cut off one of its heads (it dies unless it can survive without it); if it is immune to slashing, lacks a head or is too big, it instead takes an extra 6d8 slashing. (Legendary, requires attunement; slashing sword)

+1 to attack and damage (maul). Giant's Bane, when attuned while wearing a belt of giant strength and gauntlets of ogre power: your Strength increases by 4 (max 30); on a natural 20 against a giant it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution save or die. 5 charges: thrown, it can release a thunderclap (DC 17 Constitution or stunned until your next turn). (Legendary)

Action, once per dawn: throw it and speak the command word. It becomes a 5-ft-wide line of lightning to a target within 120 ft; creatures in the line (not you or the target) make a DC 13 Dexterity save, 4d6 lightning on a failure, half on a success. Then make a ranged attack: on a hit, the target takes the javelin's damage plus 4d6 lightning. (Uncommon)

Extra 2d6 radiant damage against fiends and undead. If such a target has 25 hit points or fewer after the damage, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be destroyed; on a success it is frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Sheds bright light 20 ft. (Rare, requires attunement)

+1 to attack and damage (+3 against constructs). On a natural 20 it deals an extra 2d6 bludgeoning damage (4d6 against constructs); a construct with 25 hit points or fewer after the damage is destroyed. (Rare)

3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn). Action, 1 charge: each creature of your choice within 30 ft makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is frightened of you for 1 minute (it must use its action to move away from you). (Rare, requires attunement)

+2 to attack and damage. 1d8+1 charges. On a natural 20 against a creature with fewer than 100 hit points (not a construct or undead), it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or be slain, using one charge. (Very rare, requires attunement; any sword)

Bonus action, once per dawn: swear an oath against a creature you can see. Against your sworn enemy: advantage on attacks, an extra 3d6 piercing damage, no disadvantage at long range, and it can't benefit from cover other than total. (Very rare, requires attunement by an elf or half-elf; longbow)

On a natural 20 against a creature that isn't a construct or undead, it takes an extra 3d6 necrotic damage and you gain temporary hit points equal to that damage. (Rare, requires attunement; any sword)

Advantage on initiative rolls. You and companions within 30 ft can't be surprised (unless incapacitated by something other than nonmagical sleep), and the weapon wakes you when combat begins. (Uncommon, requires attunement; any weapon)
+3 to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Set its damage dice to match the weapon. (Very rare)
Any medium or heavy armor except hide (set its AC to match). Any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit. (Uncommon)
Any medium or heavy armor except hide (set its AC to match). No Strength requirement and no disadvantage on Stealth. (Uncommon)
Chain shirt with +1 AC. You are proficient with it even without medium armor proficiency. (Rare)

+1 AC. Bonus action: it takes the appearance of normal clothing or another armor (no change to weight or bulk). (Rare)
